g.text: Member B - Customer Request Submission & Clarification Activity
MB-ACT-0.2 compatibility candidate, 2026-09-14
B01 Open portal; compose original message,
optional order reference and requested outcome
B02 Optionally select evidence;
no mandatory return-category choice
Customer leaves page or supplies no response?
yes
Customer responds to current questions
B20 Provide relevant answers and/or evidence;
reasonable proof-of-purchase alternatives remain possible
B03 Validate basic input and selected files locally;
JPEG/PNG/PDF, <= 10 MiB each, <= 10 references
B04 Display safe field errors; allow local correction
no
Client validation passes?
yes
Every POST: server verifies identity, role/access, schema
and trusted idempotency scope before lookup or mutation.
Upload validates actual format/size, owner and availability.
STAGED evidence alone does not change case input.
B05 Stage each selected file via POST /v1/evidence
with Bearer and its own Idempotency-Key;
use only successfully returned evidence IDs
B06 POST /v1/cases with Bearer, Idempotency-Key
and CreateCaseRequest; preserve request for uncertain retry
B07b Recover same-key uncertain request or
GET current authorised case as applicable
B15 GET CustomerCaseView; show server-confirmed progress
B18 GET own current case; display clarification.questions;
preserve question_set_id and current case_version
B19 Close/pause only local IntakeViewSession;
no cancellation request or server state transition;
reopening reloads the authorised current case
B21 Validate input; stage any new files using B05 guards;
POST /v1/cases/{id}/clarifications with Bearer, new intent key,
expected_case_version, question_set_id, answers, evidence_ids
B07 Authenticate and validate; resolve accepted replay
before checking admission of a fresh intent
B07a Return safe ErrorEnvelope or original readable receipt;
removed receipt -> 409 INVALID_STATE, retryable=false;
changed payload -> 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT;
no duplicate work, no automatic replacement key
yes
Rejected or previously accepted request?
fresh valid intent
B08 Atomically bind available owned STAGED evidence,
create ReturnCase SUBMITTED and original CustomerStatement,
create case-owned IntakeSession (lifecycle_state=SUBMITTED,
clarification_round=0), save receipt and intake work
B09 Return 201 CustomerCaseView after accepted commit;
UI displays accepted submission and GETs current view
B10 Start accepted intake work for current case/input;
IntakeSession.lifecycle_state=EVALUATING
B12 Validate schema, original_statement_id, case/input
and selected work binding before accepting result;
discard obsolete results; bounded recovery only for real errors
B12a Discard obsolete result or await authorised recovery
yes
Result obsolete or recovery still pending?
current result or exhausted actual error
Initial or accepted clarification failure is a real failure.
No proposal: exactly one current failure/block target.
Existing proposal: preserve it; proposal-target rules apply.
Only a later trusted Founder decision records MANUAL_HANDLING.
Missing facts, UI inactivity and request rejection are not failures.
B13 Persist actual ProcessingFailure with exact case/input
(stage=COORDINATOR); set ReturnCase ESCALATED
and IntakeSession ESCALATED_FAILURE only under current-target guards
yes
Current processing failed and recovery exhausted?
valid accepted result
Mandatory facts sufficient for investigation?
yes
missing or ambiguous facts
B14 Persist facts; transition ReturnCase to UNDER_INVESTIGATION
and IntakeSession to COMPLETE; hand off to UC-02
B16 Atomically persist accepted facts and current ClarificationSet;
ReturnCase=AWAITING_INFORMATION; IntakeSession=AWAITING_CLARIFICATION;
increment internal clarification_round when a new question set is issued
B17 Only after commit, notify Customer via NotificationPort;
notification failure does not undo accepted facts or replay intake
B22 Authenticate/authorise and validate request;
apply the same accepted-replay/retention rules as B07
Accepted replay or admission rejected?
yes
fresh request
B23 Return original readable receipt or safe error;
no new input or analysis; stale version/question/state -> reload;
never manufacture an escalation target
B24 Atomically recheck owner, AWAITING_INFORMATION,
current question set/version and requested answers;
bind available owned STAGED references; append CLARIFICATION statements;
advance case/input versions, invalidate stale derived authority,
set IntakeSession CLARIFICATION_RECEIVED and save intake work/receipt
B25 Return 202 CustomerCaseView for accepted input;
UI GETs current view; original statement is not overwritten
Accepted clarification needs evaluation?
yes
B11 Return non-authoritative CoordinatorResult
(facts, evidence_matrix, questions and exact input references);
preserve missing/conflicting/not-applicable distinctions
End Customer
Customer Portal (Next.js)
API & Domain Service
Coordinator Agent (A's AI Intake Role)
B original delivery: 92cd717; A/AI-assisted compatibility correction, pending B acceptance.
AH-01 -> UC-01 / UC-01E -> M-B.02 (Criterion C8); implementation remains planned.
Missing information stays AWAITING_INFORMATION; UC-01E can repeat beyond three rounds.
No seven-day business expiry, customer rejection/withdrawal API, or automatic manual decision.
Stored content is append-only while available; F.07 retention/tombstones still apply.
